facts.rationale: Replaces the misleading description of the mode as null with the exact numeric comparison and preserves the cross-file distinction between trail detachment and subsequent termination.
facts.value: On absorption, unconditionally calls shared PK Thunder teardown and returns true. Teardown resets head hit state, clears the stored originating-fighter reference, detaches every non-null trail and clears its slot, and clears x13. Ness is notified only when xF04 is non-null, equals the current Item.owner, and numeric mode xF00 equals 0. Detached trails have their ball links cleared and request termination on their subsequent animation checks; the helper does not synchronously free them.
